decisions.reason: Conditioning production of the print version does not change the requirement to eliminate visible article-end whitespace in the magazine layout.
The digital flipbook remains required; the stated 6am launch preference is project scheduling rather than a change to the digital deliverable.
Making the print output conditional does not alter the existing requirement to remediate low-quality article images.
The specified cover-listed articles must still be included in the magazine regardless of whether a print version is produced.
The source does not relax advertisement sharpness for the digital magazine or otherwise change this quality requirement.
The polished, brand-aligned visual style remains applicable to the magazine independently of conditional print production.
The print-output condition does not affect the established restriction on using red within the magazine layout.
The magazine still requires compilation and layout from supplied materials; only production of the separate print output became conditional.
Conditional print production does not change the source from which magazine articles must be obtained.
The approved article typeface and weight remain applicable to the digital magazine and are not changed by the print condition.
The future word-count guidance addresses article layout and whitespace, not whether the current issue receives a print output.
The table of contents must still match finalized magazine pagination for the digital output regardless of conditional print production.
